manual_findings.photo0-native256: WGCAN RAW/Malvar shows a fine periodic grid on the canopy. All methods lose fine suspension lines; neither retained control resolves them well.
manual_findings.photo1-native256: WGCAN RAW/Malvar has a pronounced checker/grid pattern in sky and building detail and softer cloud boundaries. Retained controls have cleaner edges and sky.
manual_findings.overcast-sky: All denoisers suppress noise; WGCAN has a residual broad gradient/patchiness. Independent ISO100 reference is grainier and is not GT.
manual_findings.building-detail: WGCAN building detail is soft and somewhat mottled. Retained controls show clearer rails and roof truss.
manual_findings.foliage: WGCAN foliage retains grain and blocky texture. Retained controls are smoother; independent ISO100 contains finer foliage, with aperture and exposure differences.
manual_findings.chain-link-fence: WGCAN turns fine diagonal wires into a mottled periodic pattern of holes. Retained controls preserve the mesh much more clearly.
